ValidationRule.description: Users with the custom permission 'Cannot Decline Credit Review' won't be able to decline a CR
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Permission.Cannot_Decline_Credit_Reviews = TRUE, ISCHANGED(StageName ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Declined'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'NF Decline'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Internal Decline') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lender Relations Specialists are not eligible to decline Credit Reviews
